title: Screen settings for :name
subtitle: Hours, sound, screensaver and the QR for this room. The QR changes once an hour.

sense.title: Sense
sense.hint: Turn this on for a D1S. The screen then measures temperature, humidity, CO₂ and air quality. Leave it off for a D1.

qr.title: QR for this room
qr.hint: The screen shows this code. It changes once an hour. A scan opens the same report page as the sticker on the door.

code.title: Pairing
code.hint: The device shows a screen where you type the code. Then you confirm here which device it is.

pending.title: A screen is asking to pair

unlink_modal.title: Unlink screen
unlink_modal.body: The device stops for this room. You can pair another screen afterwards.

errors.unit_invalid: This room does not belong to this organisation.
errors.code_invalid: This code is invalid or expired.
errors.not_pending: This request is no longer open.
